column1: # Standard human roles (spec: Roles and permissions). Domain "*" applies in every branch.
# Agent roles are loaded from each agent manifest (grants and denies)
# Wildcards only for read and write permissions; risky tools are granted one by one.
# Role hierarchy: owner > admin > supervisor > staff; accountant > viewer.
# supervisor: schedules and approvals for daily operations
# admin and owner decide cover overrides (instructions that break a scheduling rule)
